`final class ShaderVariable`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderVariable.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/ShaderVariable.java)

A variable that a shader source declares, an input, an output, a uniform or a sampler, as the translator reads and writes it again.

## Description

[`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/) creates one per `in`, `out` and `uniform` declaration, and [`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) creates its own for the uniforms that JOID adds.
The translator declares them again in the syntax of the dialect, and [`UniformBlock`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/) lays out the uniforms from them.

- [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/#from-source-to-program)
